name: VMAF (libvmaf)
notes: 2026-11-01: Netflix full-reference video quality metric via the vmaf CLI or FFmpeg libvmaf filter.
2026-11-15: Homebrew package route not confirmed; model use depends on selected model, input alignment, preprocessing and version.
summary: Netflix video quality metric exposed as a CLI, C/Python libraries, or FFmpeg libvmaf filter. It compares aligned reference and distorted video and writes pooled and per-frame scores/logs. New v1 models broaden model choices for display resolution and viewing distance; results depend on model, alignment and preprocessing.
use_when: Compare an encode to its source using a documented full-reference metric
Use libvmaf in FFmpeg when the encode workflow already uses filtergraphs
avoid_when: Use ffprobe for stream metadata without a reference comparison
Use subjective review for aesthetic judgement or artifacts outside model scope

install.macos: Build/install libvmaf and an FFmpeg build configured with --enable-libvmaf; formula availability unverified

assessment.rationale: libvmaf v3.2.1 released 2026-09-14; repository documents active model work in 2026. BSD-2-Clause-Patent. Distinct full-reference quality scoring and FFmpeg integration provide a measurable comparison workflow.
